name: EOD 2026-09-10
body:
> Eod · Summit Az · 2026-09-10

Wednesday. Site-wide Summit AZ design unification.

# Summit Plumbing Pros AZ
See [Summit Plumbing Pros AZ (Hub)](lib:brain-summit-plumbing-pros-az-hub).
- Matched 142 pages to the Drain Cleaning design (Summit brand colours, Poppins and Montserrat instead of Elementor defaults). Copy, links, permalinks and SEO unchanged.
- Rebuilt 6 old photo-background heroes (pipe lining, garbage disposals, water filtration, water pressure, leaking pipe repair, common pipe problems).
- Fixed 780 broken icons across 116 pages by restoring 64 deleted Media Library records (files were still on the server).
- Fixed dark-on-dark text on 171 pages.
- Added the navy card style to 23 pages and saved a reusable "Card Grid - Navy 6 Box" template.
- Removed a duplicate Areas We Serve section on /water-softeners/ (only page affected of 172) and rebuilt its broken "Why Choose" boxes; the same box fix applied to 22 more pages.
- Submitted all 23 fixed pages to GSC, no quota block.
- Found 3 pages not in Google: /plumbing-repair/ (crawled Aug 7, not indexed), /faucet-and-toilet-plumbing-services/ and /shower-bath-repair-installation-services/ (never crawled). Crawl requests in.
- Trackers: `Summit-AZ-Change-Tracker-2026-09-10.csv`, `Summit-AZ-Card-Box-Fix-2026-09-10.csv`.

# Follow-ups
- Check with Scott on 11 card bands now navy.
- Re-check the 3 unindexed pages in 1 to 2 weeks; if /plumbing-repair/ still out, rewrite to reduce overlap.
- Parent service pages (water heaters, softeners, leak detection, maintenance, fixture installation) lack FAQ sections.
- free-tankless-quote v2 and v3 still have no H1.
- Garbage Disposals "years of industry experience" wording: confirm keep or remove.
